title: Administrator
description:
Plant & Parts Administrator

Location: Redruth
Salary: 25,000 - 30,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 - 17:00

We are seeking an organised and proactive Plant & Parts Administrator to join our busy team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills and an interest in stock control, plant, fleet, or stores management.

Working as part of the Plant Department, you will play a key role in ensuring parts, tools, and equipment are accurately managed and readily available to support operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the day-to-day management and organisation of the plant and parts stores.
- Monitor, track, and record stock levels, including plant parts, tools, and fleet-related items.
- Maintain accurate inventory records and update internal databases and management systems.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of stock-control and parts-management systems.
- Assist with ordering, receiving, checking, and storing parts and equipment.
- Liaise with site teams to understand requirements and ensure parts and equipment are available when needed.
- Communicate with suppliers and colleagues to support the efficient movement and distribution of stock.
- Carry out regular stock checks and investigate discrepancies.
- Maintain an organised stores environment, ensuring all items are correctly labelled, recorded, and stored.
- Provide general administrative support to the Plant Department, including data entry, filing, and record management.
- Support the wider team with additional duties as required.

About You
- Previous experience in an administrative, stores, stock control, plant, fleet, or parts environment would be advantageous.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and internal computer systems.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively.
- Good communication skills with the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.
- Accurate data entry and record-keeping skills.
- A proactive and flexible approach to work.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of 25,000 - 30,000, depending on experience.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Monday to Friday working hours with no weekend work.
- Opportunity to join a supportive and growing team.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

If you are an organised administrator looking for a varied role where you can make a real impact within a busy Plant Department, we'd love to hear from you. For more information or to apply for this Plant & Parts Administrator position, please contact Louise Fletcher, Berry Recruitment, on (phone number removed).

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Temporary Payroll Assistant - £14.00 - £15.00 per hour - Full or Part Time - Initial 3 Month Contract with Potential for Extension

An established business is seeking a Payroll Assistant to join its payroll team on a temporary basis. This role has been created to provide additional support during a particularly busy period and will focus on payroll administration, data entry, reconciliations, and supporting the accurate processing of monthly payrolls.

Working as part of an experienced payroll team, you will play a key role in ensuring payroll information is processed accurately and on time across multiple payrolls, while assisting with HMRC reporting and payroll administration duties.

Key Responsibilities

Processing and maintaining payroll records

Accurate input and validation of payroll data

Supporting the monthly processing of two payrolls covering approximately 700 employees across multiple entities

Processing new starters and leavers

Assisting with payroll reconciliations and balancing activities

Supporting HMRC submissions, RTI reporting and general payroll compliance

Assisting with statutory payments including SSP and other payroll-related calculations

Supporting pension administration and submissions

Working with time and attendance data to ensure payroll accuracy

Investigating and resolving payroll discrepancies

Responding to payroll-related queries from employees and managers

Providing general administrative support to the wider payroll function

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a Payroll Assistant, Payroll Administrator, or similar payroll support role, together with a good understanding of payroll processes and administration. You will have excellent attention to detail, strong data entry skills, and be comfortable working with large volumes of information while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

You should be organised, dependable, and capable of managing priorities within a deadline-driven environment. Knowledge of UK payroll legislation and HMRC requirements would be advantageous, as would experience using payroll software such as MorePay or time and attendance systems such as Kronos, although neither is essential.

Please apply ASAP to Elle Benjamin quoting reference EB11279.

title: Client Bookkeeper
description:
Client Bookkeeper - Helston - £27,000 - £35,000

If you're an experienced bookkeeper looking for a role where you'll work with a varied client portfolio, become part of a supportive team and continue developing your skills, this could be an excellent opportunity to consider.

A highly respected accountancy practice in Helston is looking to recruit an experienced Client Bookkeeper to join its team. This is a varied role offering regular client exposure, a broad range of bookkeeping responsibilities and plenty of opportunity for personal and professional development.

As Client Bookkeeper, your responsibilities will include:
- Completing day-to-day bookkeeping for a varied portfolio of clients
- Supporting the maintenance of accounts payable and accounts receivable records
- Completing regular bank reconciliations and ensuring financial records remain accurate and up to date
- Preparing VAT reports and supporting clients with their ongoing VAT requirements
- Assisting with wider accounting duties and ad-hoc tasks as required
- Working closely with clients and colleagues to ensure information is accurate and deadlines are met

The successful Client Bookkeeper will:

Have previous bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice environment and be confident managing a varied workload across multiple clients.

You may be part or fully AAT qualified, or alternatively be qualified by experience. Strong communication skills will be essential, alongside the ability to build positive and professional relationships with both clients and colleagues.

You'll be organised, accurate and comfortable taking ownership of your work, whilst also enjoying being part of a successful and supportive team.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced bookkeeper to join a successful accountancy practice where your contribution will be valued, your skills can continue to develop and you'll become an important part of the wider team.

Please apply to this Client Bookkeeper position or contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, quoting reference JVS11287, for a confidential conversation.

title: Part Time Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper - Redruth (outskirts) - Salary negotiable depending on experience

Trial Balance Consulting are delighted to have been exclusively engaged by a long-established and highly regarded Cornish business, who seek to recruit a part-time Bookkeeper to join their team on a permanent basis.

The role will see you work 2 days per week (16hrs), with one of those days required to be a Monday (the client is flexible around the second working day). There may be scope for the hours to vary in the future for the right candidate, and whilst the role will initially be site based, there is potential for some working from home to develop.

Working with an experienced Finance Manager the successful candidate will take responsibility for a varied range of transactional finance, bookkeeping and payroll administration duties.

Using Sage Line 50, the role will involve the following key responsibilities:
- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and transactional finance duties
- Process purchase and sales ledger transactions
- Maintain accurate financial records and undertake regular bank reconciliations
- Assist with payroll administration
- Support with month-end procedures and reporting
- Liaise with suppliers and other contacts as required
- Provide general support to the wider finance function

For this role we seek an experienced Bookkeeper or Accounts Assistant with a good understanding of day-to-day transactional finance procedures. Previous experience using Sage Line 50 will be essential and some knowledge of payroll administration would be advantageous.

We're looking for someone organised, reliable and comfortable working independently, whilst also being a good team player with strong communication skills.

title: Receptionist/Admin Assistant
description: We have an exciting opportunity for a cheerful, friendly and patient focused individual to join our team of experienced and efficient Receptionist/Admin Assistants and the wider administrative and clerical team at Bolitho House, Penzance supporting the Penwith Community Mental Health Team and Dementia in Older People's Mental Health Service.The post holder should demonstrate a caring and sensitive approach to their work and be able to communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues, patients, carers, the general public and representatives from other hospitals and organisations.This is a full-time post working 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday 08:45 to 17:00 The post holder will be required to provide a comprehensive service as part of the administration team, the Receptionist/Admin Assistant will provide the public face of the Integrated Community Mental Health Team (ICMHT) and Dementia in Older People's Mental Health Service (DOPMH) assisting service users, their families and carers, and all other professionals, as well as providing general reception duties, taking telephone calls, and using electronic systems, with a high degree of accuracy, always ensuring efficient and effective levels of service, on a daily basis. There will be extensive liaison with service users, GP's, clinical staff within the service and the general public, providing an excellent customer service to facilitate efficient and sensitive communication. Information received may be of a confidential or sensitive nature and will require courteous and diplomatic handling. title: Medical Receptionist
description: As a Receptionist at The Three Spires Medical Practice (based in Truro, Cornwall) you will help our patients feel comfortable when they phone or visit the Practice. You will use your empathy and customer service skills to welcome patients, answer the phones, deal with enquiries and book appointments. You will be someone who is calm, a great listener and have the skills to explain sensitive information in a way thats easy to understand. You will have good IT and keyboard skills and ideally have experience in a healthcare environment or on a busy reception desk. We are a busy, forward-thinking Practice with over 18000 patients who are cared for by a team of dedicated GPs, nurses, HCAs and physiotherapists. Working closely with your colleagues, you will ensure that our patients receive a positive experience each and every time they contact the Practice. You will be confident in dealing with the public, over the telephone or face to face. You will have great communication and organisational skills. Two posts available: 26.5 hours (Monday, Tuesday, Friday) and 27.5 hours (Wednesday, Thursday, Friday) per week are available on a permanent basis. Our shifts start at 8.00 am and our latest finish is at 6.30 pm. Main Duties & Responsibilities To answer incoming telephone calls in a prompt and professional manner, responding to each call appropriately and accurately, recording and relaying information as required. Provide patients with information as requested (at all times taking consideration to rules and procedures regarding confidentiality). To receive patients in the reception area noting their attendance on the computerised appointment system and scheduling appointments as requested. Oversee and supervise the patient waiting area. Extraction of patient medical records. Produce computerised repeat prescriptions. To enter and update information on computerised systems including registration information. General and confidential filing, including records, reports and mail. General duties in connection with Practice administration.
